column1: # Long Mamba architecture ablation, 9/29. One factor at a time around the v1 base (vanilla, BOUNDARY=index, d_model 64,
# 4 layers, d_state 16, expand 2, geo_bins, wd1e-3). The base itself is block 5 (Lvindex_*, same log tag). 3 seeds, 1 per job.
# Bigger variants (8 layers, d_state 64, d_model 128, expand 4) use batch 4 x accum 8 (same effective 32) to fit memory.
# d_conv is not ablated: the causal_conv1d kernel only supports widths 2-4.
